summary: Full backend + frontend verification for the new Purchase Requests and Car Finder Requests features (iteration 3). 16/16 backend pytest cases pass against external BACKEND URL. Frontend pages /start-your-vehicle-purchase and /find-a-car render with correct H1 text, all specified test-ids, correct checkbox counts (7 warranties; 21 interior / 11 exterior / 14 infotainment / 17 safety). Header 'FIND A CAR' dropdown exposes the 3 required items with correct hrefs. Admin Inbox shows 11 tabs including 'Purchase Requests' and 'Car Finder'; filtering by the new kinds returns data and strips dlFile base64. Admin auth protection verified. Resend customer emails fail only because sandbox key can only email the verified admin address - environmental, not a code defect. No regressions in existing health, vehicles, or contacts endpoints.

minor.issue: Customer confirmation emails fail via Resend because sandbox key restricts sending to the admin's own email (verified in backend.err.log). Admin notification emails succeed. Requires domain verification at resend.com/domains to enable outbound to customers.

action_items: (Optional / non-blocking) Verify a sending domain in Resend and switch SENDER_EMAIL so customer confirmation emails deliver outside the admin inbox. Currently only admin notifications reach the recipient.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is approaching 620 lines and has a repetitive BackgroundTasks + insert pattern across ~12 endpoints; extract a helper `submit_and_notify(collection, model, subject, data)` to reduce duplication.
PurchaseRequest endpoint uses 36 Form() fields inline - consider a Pydantic Form model or a dataclass-based dependency to keep the signature readable and reduce drift risk.

admin_submissions.submission_counts builds a query that overwrites `$and`/`$or` in list_submissions when both read and archived are False-filtered; verified it works but is fragile. A small query builder helper would be safer.
models.PurchaseRequest.dlFile is typed as `Optional[dict]`; consider a typed sub-model (FileBlob) for self-documenting responses and stricter validation.
seed_data_creation: Added multiple TEST_-prefixed purchase_requests and car_finder_requests via the public POST endpoints during testing; they are visible in the Admin Inbox (Purchase Requests tab: 5 rows, Car Finder tab: 6 rows).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new endpoints (POST/GET /api/purchase-requests, POST/GET /api/car-finder-requests, /api/stats with new counters, admin list+detail+patch+counts for purchase_requests and car_finder_requests) have full pytest coverage in test_new_submissions.py. JWT auth (Bearer token) continues to work. Frontend pages /start-your-vehicle-purchase and /find-a-car include all required data-testid attributes. Header FIND A CAR dropdown is a hover menu (use `.hover()` not `.click()` in Playwright). Admin Inbox tabs test-ids: tab-purchase_requests, tab-car_finder_requests.
